texts.zh:
我们的传感器检测到一个从[from.Planet.GetName]的撞击坑深处发出的异常通讯信号。

震波拓扑扫描显示存在一个地下洞穴网络，其塌陷的洞口正在撞击坑中心。与此同时，我们的放射仪探测到从该地点发出的微弱的引力辐射痕迹，这带来的问题比答案更多。
texts.en:
Our sensors have detected an irregular communications signal emanating from deep within an impact crater on [from.Planet.GetName].

Seismic topology scans reveal a network of subterranean caverns with a collapsed entrance at the center of the crater. Alongside this, our radiology equipment is detecting faint traces of gravitational radiation emanating from the site, posing more questions than it answers.

sections.zh:
我们的传感器检测到一个从[from.Planet.GetName]的撞击坑深处发出的异常通讯信号。

震波拓扑扫描显示存在一个地下洞穴网络，其塌陷的洞口正在撞击坑中心。与此同时，我们的放射仪探测到从该地点发出的微弱的引力辐射痕迹，这带来的问题比答案更多。
sections.en:
Our sensors have detected an irregular communications signal emanating from deep within an impact crater on [from.Planet.GetName].

Seismic topology scans reveal a network of subterranean caverns with a collapsed entrance at the center of the crater. Alongside this, our radiology equipment is detecting faint traces of gravitational radiation emanating from the site, posing more questions than it answers.

texts.zh:
在[from.Planet.GetName]的撞击坑中的发掘工作中找到了一些碎片。就是这些碎片释放出我们之前在轨道上探测到的强力引力辐射。

在通往地下洞穴网络的入口打通之后，[leader.GetName]正着手寻找通讯信号的源头。
texts.en:
Excavation work has uncovered fragmented debris within the impact crater on [from.Planet.GetName]. These shattered pieces are emitting strong traces of the gravitational radiation previously detected from orbit.

With access to the subsurface cavern network secured [leader.GetName] is now ready to trace the communications signal to its source.

texts.zh:
我们找到了[from.Planet.GetName]上通讯信号的源头：一座深深穿透行星地壳且结构损坏的巨大设施。

尽管通讯阵列由于接触酸性环境而发生腐蚀，但它仍在以一种不明语言发出通讯，尝试与远方的实体联络。

我们用特制的重力夹把这台装置夹好后又牢牢地固定在基岩上。需要进一步研究才能确定其实际用途。
texts.en:
We have traced the communications signal on [from.Planet.GetName] to its source: a large, structurally-damaged construct which has deeply penetrated the planet's crust.

Corroded from acidic exposure, its communications array continues to transmit in an unfamiliar language, attempting to make contact with a distant entity.

Secured in place with specialized gravitational clamps, the device is firmly anchored in the bedrock. Further research will be necessary to ascertain its true purpose.

texts.zh:
经过我们细致的分析，现在终于部分弄明白这台[from.Planet.GetName]上的装置的作用了。这台机器是一种粗糙且具有破坏性的环境改造装置。

它旨在通过目标资源的受激辐射增长来照射本地生物圈，在此过程中引起级联效应，破坏星球的生态系统。该过程以提高整颗行星的毒性为代价，为其使用者带来大量容易开采的资源。

尽管这种过程的具体原理我们并未完全理解，但这台装置的通讯频率已经顺利解码，从中还发现两个发出一样信号的地点。
texts.en:
After detailed analysis, we now have a partial understanding of the construct found on [from.Planet.GetName]. This machine is a crude and destructive terraforming device.

Designed to irradiate native biospheres through stimulated radiation growth of targeted resources, it causes a cascading effect that devastates the planet's ecosystem in the process. This provides its user with abundant extractable materials at the cost of raising general toxicity across the planet.

While the exact workings of this process remain only partially understood, we have successfully decoded the device's communications frequency, identifying two additional locations transmitting the same signal.

texts.zh: 这项技术背后的锐意创业者显然对利润优化有着浓厚的兴趣，我们可以追寻着这一发现学到很多东西。
texts.en: The entrepreneurial trailblazers behind this technology clearly had an affinity for profit streamlining, we could learn a great deal from pursuing this discovery.

texts.zh: 调查这些地点或许能获得更多关于这项科技的洞见。
texts.en: Investigating these sites may yield further insight into the technology.

texts.zh: [from.Planet.GetName]上的一台毁坏的环境改造装置残骸依旧在向星系中的多个地点发出信号。调查这些地点可以揭开更多关于这项危险科技的秘密。
texts.en: The remains of a destructive terraforming device on [from.Planet.GetName] continue to emit a signal to multiple locations across the galaxy. Investigating these sites will reveal more information about this dangerous technology.

texts.zh: 追踪着与[from.Planet.GetName]上的装置完全一致的通讯频率找到的这一位置，而这里又发现了一台受损的装置。进行研究可以取得对他们的破坏性环境改造能力更深入的洞见。
texts.en: An identical communications frequency to the one emitted by the construct found on [from.Planet.GetName] has been traced to this site, where another damaged device has been located. Studying it will yield further insight into their destructive terraforming capabilities.

texts.zh:
我们顺利地在[from.GetName]发现了另一台受损的环境改造装置。与起初的那台不同，这台装置中还剩有一些燃料以供研究，这才让我们明白其输出放射性的驱动力是暗物质。

该装置通过关键的分子键迁移来加速目标资源的生长。该过程牺牲周围生物圈的细胞完整性来促进其发展。
texts.en:
We have successfully uncovered another damaged terraforming device on [from.GetName]. Unlike the original construct, this one has retained some of its fuel source for study, revealing Dark Matter as the driving force of its radiation output.

The device accelerates growth of targeted resources by metastasizing key molecular bonds. This promotes their development at the expense of the surrounding biosphere's cellular integrity.

texts.zh: 就资源开采而言，这台装置对星球稳定度的完全漠视相当鼓舞人心。
texts.en: The sheer disregard this device shows to planetary stability in the face of resource exploitation is inspirational.

texts.zh:
这台机器通过将辐射波导通过晶化折射阵列，在避免行星核心坍塌的前提下以引力分子操纵来改造目标星球。

恢复的记录显示出了第四个未爆装置的位置。
texts.en:
By channeling radiation waves through a crystallized refractory array, this machine can terraform its target using gravitational molecular manipulation without collapsing the planetary core in on itself.

Recovered records indicate the location of a fourth, undetonated device.

texts.zh: 至于这台装置是如何实现又如何避免行星级引力坍缩的我们还不清楚。也许在剩下的通讯地点能够找到答案。
texts.en: How the device manages to do this and prevent gravitational collapse on a planetary scale remains unclear. This answer may be found at the remaining communications site.

texts.zh: 我们在[planet.GetName]找到了第四个还未引爆的环境改造装置。将其取回之后就能让我们完全理解这一科技了。
texts.en: We have located a fourth, as yet undetonated terraforming device on [planet.GetName]. Recovering it will fill the gaps in our understanding of this technology.

texts.zh: 我们找到了未启用的第四台装置，它完好地躺在[from.GetName]的地上。我们可以分析它的控制结构来获取复制该科技的知识。
texts.en: We have successfully located an intact fourth device, inactive on the surface of [from.GetName]. Analyzing its control architecture would give us the final knowledge needed to replicate this technology.

texts.zh: 一旦掌握了这项技术，我们就能从星系获得惊人的利润空间，至于环境问题微不足道。这对[controller.GetName]而言可是绝佳的机会。
texts.en: The staggering profit margins we will be able to reap from the galaxy once we master this technology outweigh the paltry environmental concerns. This is a golden opportunity for the [controller.GetName].

texts.zh: 这种技术在星系范围内自由部署的潜在后果引发了重大问题。
texts.en: The potential ramifications of freely deploying such technology on a galactic scale raise significant questions.

texts.zh: 也许在这些威胁被用来对付我们之前把它们从这个星系中消除会更好。
texts.en: Perhaps it would be better to remove this threat from the galaxy before it is used against us.

texts.zh: 也许把这些设备可能会给星系带来的危险移除也许会更好。
texts.en: Perhaps it would be better if the potential risk these devices pose was removed from the galaxy.

label.zh: 我们还等什么？开始研究啊！
label.en: What are we waiting for? Begin the study!

label.zh: 我们还等什么？开始研究啊！
label.en: What are we waiting for? Begin the study!

label.zh: 风险远大于收益，摧毁装置。
label.en: The risks outweigh the rewards, destroy the device.

texts.zh: 通过分析[planet.GetName]上找到的这台装置的控制结构，我们就能复制这项科技为自己所用。
texts.en: By analyzing the control architecture of the device found on [planet.GetName], we will be able to replicate this technology for our own use.

texts.zh:
在研究[from.GetName]上的这台装置时，我们无意中触发了一个故障保险，警报赫然响彻所有频率。尽管最初预测不会有人应答，但还是有一架自动无人机进入了我们的领土。

我们的所有招呼都只得到相同的答复：

“尊敬的用户您好，记录显示您未经允许擅自仿制MKIII型地质辐射矩阵，该行为违反了科伯恩公司最终用户许可协议。

我们将行使法律权限，以极端强制措施终止您的企图。您有任何投诉可以直接联系我们的客服无人机。”
texts.en:
While studying the device on [from.GetName] we inadvertently triggered a failsafe, resulting in an all frequencies alert siren. Despite initial predictions this would be unanswered, an automated drone has entered our territory.

Our hails all receive the same response:

"Greetings valued customer, our records show you are attempting to create an unlicensed version of the latest MKIII Georadiation Matrix, a clear violation of CoburnCorp's End User License Agreement.

We will now be enforcing our legal authority to terminate your attempts with extreme prejudice. Any complaints can be directed towards our customer service drones."

texts.zh: 如果他们的这股勤奋劲不误我们的事儿就挺鼓舞人心的。
texts.en: Their diligence would be inspiring if it wasn't currently delaying our own work.

label.zh: 我们可不会跟“客服”多废话。
label.en: We will not negotiate with "customer support".

texts.zh:
随着信号接通，一段古老的音乐传来，自动服务台无人机上线了。

尊敬的用户您好，我们能看到您正在擅自仿制无证的MKIII型地质辐射矩阵。需要什么帮助？
texts.en:
As the connection goes live, archaic music plays before the automated help desk drone comes online.

Greetings valued customer, we can see that you are creating an unlicensed version of a MKIII Georadiation Matrix. How can we help you today?

responses.zh: “在科伯恩公司消费都可以附赠一台远程客户满意轨道卫星，确保产品的确保正常运作和客户终身留存。我们的内部能源储备可以使用数个世纪。”
responses.en: "Every purchase from CoburnCorp is deployed with a remote customer satisfaction orbital satellite to ensure proper operation and lifetime consumer retention. Our internal energy stores allow us to operate for centuries."

label.en: Can we talk to your administrator?

responses.zh: “很遗憾，我们的所有行政人员都已经去世了。但我们对客户满意度的承诺能超过生物寿命好几倍。”
responses.en: "Unfortunately, the last living administrator has expired. However, our commitment to customer satisfaction is capable of outlasting several biological lifespans."

label.zh: 我们只是捡了些破烂而已。
label.en: We assumed we were salvaging ruins.

responses.zh: “记录在册的有效理由中不包含有无知这一项。MKIII型地质辐射矩阵的使用条款已经在购买时进行了详尽叙述 。”
responses.en: "Ignorance does not register as a valid excuse. The terms of use for your MKIII Georadiation Matrix were explained in detail at the time of purchase."

label.en: We are willing to renew our subscription.

responses.zh: “荣幸无比，只要收到3000能量币管理费我们就会尽快签署文件。款项到位后我们将认为该事态已解决并退出。”
responses.en: "Fantastic to hear, we'll get the paperwork signed once we receive the administration fee of 3000 Energy Credits. On receipt of these funds we will consider this matter settled and disengage."

label.zh: 我们不会买这台装置的。

responses.zh: “那就是打算偷咯？这下问题就简单了，我们的防盗措施非常致命。希望你们也能考虑一下我们的殡葬服务。”
responses.en: "Then you admit to theft? That makes this much simpler, our anti-theft protocols are quite deadly. We hope you will consider our funeral products for your upcoming needs."

responses.zh:
“感谢您续订MKIII型地质辐射矩阵的使用许可证。希望您可以像我们以此盈利一样可以物尽其用。”

支付了款项之后，这台无人机便消失在了无边的星河
responses.en:
"Thank you for renewing your purchase of a MKIII Georadiation Matrix license. We hope you find this device as useful as we find it profitable."

With the fee paid, the drone disappears into the wider galaxy

label.zh: 勒索来了。给它点颜色瞧瞧。

texts.zh: 处理掉了客服无人机后，我们现在就可以继续逆向工程这台地质辐射矩阵了。
texts.en: With the customer service drones dealt with, we are now able to resume retro-engineering the Georadiation Matrix.

texts.zh: 通过分析[planet.GetName]上找到的这台装置的控制结构，我们就能复制这项科技为自己所用。
texts.en: By analyzing the control architecture of the device found on [planet.GetName], we will be able to replicate this technology for our own use.

texts.zh: 通过孜孜不倦的企业家级效率，我们重新设计了MKIII地质辐射矩阵，通过改进操作方法来产生最大的利润。
texts.en: Through relentless entrepreneurial efficiency, we have retro-engineered the MKIII Georadiation Matrix, refining its operational methods to yield maximum profit.

texts.zh: 通过深入的研究工作，我们得以重新设计MKIII地质辐射矩阵，通过改进流程解锁了其全部的潜力。
texts.en: After extensive study, we have successfully retro-engineered the MKIII Georadiation Matrix, unlocking its potential with added improvements to the process.

texts.zh: 通过将放射性分子去稳技术整合进环境改造设备，现在我们可以刺激高价值资源的生长了。
texts.en: By integrating radioactive molecular destabilization into our terraforming equipment, we can stimulate the growth of valuable resources.

texts.zh:
我们成功拆解了[from.GetName]上的装置，将所有可能重新利用的材料都回收了。

随着这台装置的破坏，它的前身也被摧毁了，这种毁灭性性技术的秘密就这样永远地消失在星系中。
texts.en:
We have successfully dismantled the device on [from.GetName], salvaging any materials that could be repurposed for our benefit.

With this device destroyed and its predecessors in ruin, the secrets of this destructive technology are lost to the galaxy forever.

texts.zh: [from.Planet.GetName]上找到的设施发出的通讯频率还指向这个地点，我们在这里又找到了一台受损的设备。进行研究可以取得对他们的破坏性环境改造能力更深入的洞见。
texts.en: The communications frequency emitted by the construct found on [from.Planet.GetName] has also been traced to this site, where another damaged device has been located. Studying it will yield further insight into their destructive terraforming capabilities.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]上又顺利取回了另一件受损的环境改造装置，由于折射阵列损坏导致激活失败，它被生长出的晶体包裹着。

通过对这台仪器的密切调查，我们确定了用于聚焦辐射瞄准的方法。通过利用可控调制反馈回路，该结构能够直接瞄准并刺激预设资源的增长。
texts.en:
We have successfully uncovered another damaged terraforming device on [from.GetName], encased in crystal growths caused by a misfire from a broken refractor array.

Through close observation of the apparatus, we have identified the methods used for focused radiation targeting. By utilizing controlled modulating feedback loops, the construct is able to directly target and stimulate the growth of a pre-determined resource.

texts.zh:
以此可以在避免行星全面重力坍缩的前提下进行高强度环境改造。

恢复的记录显示出了第四台未爆装置的位置。
texts.en:
This allows for high-intensity terraforming, without the risk of complete planetary gravitational collapse.

Recovered records indicate the location of a fourth, undetonated device.

texts.zh: 然而，产生这种辐射的确切物质仍未确定；尽管激活失败，这台装置的燃料储备还是耗尽了。这个答案或许能在余下的通信站点找到。
texts.en: However, the exact substance used to generate this radiation remains unidentified; the device's fuel reserves depleted despite its misfire. This answer may be found at the remaining communications site.
